description: This file provides utility functions for handling date and time operations within the Fineract project, including parsing, formatting, comparison, and obtaining system or tenant-specific date-time instances.

classes.name: DateUtils
classes.description: A final utility class providing static methods for date and time handling, including comparisons, parsing, formatting, and obtaining tenant/system-specific date-time objects.

methods.name: getSystemZoneId
methods.description: Returns the system default ZoneId.

methods.name: getDateTimeZoneOfTenant
methods.description: Returns the ZoneId associated with the current tenant.

methods.name: getLocalDateOfTenant
methods.description: Returns the current date for the tenant's timezone.

methods.name: getLocalDateTimeOfTenant
methods.description: Returns the current LocalDateTime for the tenant's timezone, optionally truncated.

methods.name: getOffsetDateTimeOfTenant
methods.description: Returns the current OffsetDateTime for the tenant's timezone, optionally truncated.

methods.name: getOffsetDateTimeOfTenantFromLocalDate
methods.description: Converts a LocalDate to an OffsetDateTime at the start of the day in tenant's timezone.

methods.name: getLocalDateTimeOfSystem
methods.description: Returns the current system LocalDateTime, optionally truncated.

methods.name: getAuditLocalDateTime
methods.description: Returns the current UTC LocalDateTime for auditing.

methods.name: getAuditOffsetDateTime
methods.description: Returns the current UTC OffsetDateTime for auditing.

methods.name: compare
methods.description: Compares two LocalDateTime objects, optionally truncated.

methods.name: isEqual
methods.description: Checks if two LocalDateTime objects are equal, optionally truncated.

methods.name: isEqualTenantDateTime
methods.description: Checks if a given LocalDateTime matches the current tenant date-time.

methods.name: isEqualSystemDateTime
methods.description: Checks if a given LocalDateTime matches the current system date-time.

methods.name: isBefore
methods.description: Checks if one LocalDateTime is before another.

methods.name: isAfter
methods.description: Checks if one LocalDateTime is after another.

methods.name: compare
methods.description: Compares two OffsetDateTime objects, optionally truncated, considering nulls.

methods.name: isEqual
methods.description: Checks if two OffsetDateTime objects are equal.

methods.name: isBefore
methods.description: Checks if one OffsetDateTime is before another.

methods.name: isAfter
methods.description: Checks if one OffsetDateTime is after another.

methods.name: getBusinessLocalDate
methods.description: Returns the current business local date from thread-local context.

methods.name: isEqualTenantDate
methods.description: Checks if a given LocalDate is equal to tenant's local date.

methods.name: isBeforeTenantDate
methods.description: Checks if a given LocalDate is before tenant's local date.

methods.name: isEqualBusinessDate
methods.description: Checks if a given LocalDate equals the business date.

methods.name: isBeforeBusinessDate
methods.description: Checks if a given LocalDate is before the business date.

methods.name: isAfterBusinessDate
methods.description: Checks if a given LocalDate is after the business date.

methods.name: isDateInTheFuture
methods.description: Checks if a LocalDate is in the future relative to the business date.

methods.name: isDateInRangeFromInclusiveToExclusive
methods.description: Checks if a date falls within a range [fromInclusive, upToNotInclusive).

methods.name: compare
methods.description: Compares two LocalDate objects, considering nulls.

methods.name: compareWithNullsLast
methods.description: Compares two LocalDate objects, treating null as last.

methods.name: isEqual
methods.description: Checks if two LocalDate objects are equal.

methods.name: isBefore
methods.description: Checks if one LocalDate is before another.

methods.name: isAfter
methods.description: Checks if one LocalDate is after another.

methods.name: getDifference
methods.description: Returns the difference between two dates in the specified ChronoUnit.

methods.name: getExactDifference
methods.description: Returns the difference between two dates in the specified ChronoUnit as int.

methods.name: getDifferenceInDays
methods.description: Returns the difference in days.

methods.name: getExactDifferenceInDays
methods.description: Returns the exact difference in days as int.

methods.name: minusDays
methods.description: Returns a date minus specified days.

methods.name: parseLocalDate
methods.description: Parses a string into LocalDate with optional format and locale.

methods.name: toLocalDate
methods.description: Converts date string to LocalDate based on provided locale and dateFormat.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats LocalDate into string with optional format and locale.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats LocalDateTime into string with optional format and locale.

methods.name: isDateWithinRange
methods.description: Checks if a date falls within a start and end date inclusive.

methods.name: isDateInRangeInclusive
methods.description: Checks if a date is within range, inclusively.

methods.name: isDateInRangeExclusive
methods.description: Checks if a date is within range, exclusive.

methods.name: isDateInRangeFromExclusiveToInclusive
methods.description: Checks if a date falls within range (fromexclusive, toinclusive).

methods.name: getDateFormatter
methods.description: Utility to get DateTimeFormatter for a date pattern and locale.

methods.name: getDateTimeFormatter
methods.description: Utility to get DateTimeFormatter for a datetime pattern and locale.

methods.name: convertDateTimeStringToLocalDateTime
methods.description: Converts a date-time string into LocalDateTime considering pattern and locale, with fallback time.
